scope: positive-loading identified CFA; numerical cross-engine reproducibility, not population inference certification
rationale: Strict engineering reproducibility targets declared before fits: parameter/trait differences below 0.001 latent/logit unit, probability below 0.01 percentage point, total logLik below 0.001. These do not certify Type-I error, CI coverage, global optimality or quadrature accuracy; no threshold will be tuned to observed differences.
